description: Closes one of the caller's open offers on XP to new fills -- 'cancel that open offer', 'stop waiting on those'. Fills it already took are completed purchases and stay. An offer on a single listing is cancelled with cancel_my_offer. confirm=false returns a preview; confirm=true cancels it. Requires sign-in.

confirm.description: False (default) previews. True closes the offer to new fills.

open_offer_id.description: The standing_bid_id of an open offer, from list_my_open_offers.

name: cancel_my_open_offer
title: Cancel My Open Offer
